settings.heading: Are perfume dupes as good as the original?
settings.row_content: A perfume dupe is an alternative to the original, not an identical replacement. The similarity, longevity, and overall experience can vary from one fragrance to another. But, yes they are very close to the original.

settings.heading: How long do Scentspired perfume dupes last?
settings.row_content: There isn't one exact wear time for every perfume or every person. Skin type, application, weather, and fragrance composition can all affect longevity.

settings.heading: Are perfume dupes legal?
settings.row_content: Yes. Inspired-by fragrances can be legally created as alternatives to designer fragrances, provided they don't improperly copy protected branding, packaging, or other intellectual property.

settings.heading: How do I find a perfume similar to my favorite designer scent?
settings.row_content: Start with the designer fragrance you already love and look for a Scentspired fragrance inspired by that profile. You can also shop by categorizing the occasion.

settings.heading: Can I try Scentspired fragrances before buying a full-size bottle?
settings.row_content: Scentspired discovery sets let you sample different fragrances before choosing your favorites.
